summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Invesco S&P MidCap Momentum ETF (XMMO) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P MidCap 400 Momentum index. The fund tracks an index of S&P 400 MidCap stocks selected by momentum and weighted by market cap and momentum. XMMO was launched on Mar 3, 2005 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: XMMO is an equity ETF with a total of 79 individual holdings. The top holdings are TechnipFMC stock at 4.10%, ATI Inc. at 3.96%, Roivant Sciences at 3.36%, MKS Inc. at 2.90%, and nVent Electric at 2.84%.
